Dungeon Settlers at Tokyo Game Show! 
Dungeon Settlers is now at Tokyo Game Show 2026! 
Come find us:
📍 Indie Game Area — Booth 09-E33 
Stop by our booth to play Dungeon Settlers , meet the developer guys and talk about the game.
We look forward to seeing you at Tokyo Game Show!

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2798330/view/679635858932892079 
Archer Balance Reverted 
Dear Community,
First of all, we would like to sincerely thank everyone who has played and supported Dungeon Settlers since its Early Access launch.
We carefully read the reviews and feedback shared through Steam, Discord, QQ, and other community channels. Both constructive criticism and words of encouragement help us understand your experience and continue improving the game.
After reviewing your feedback regarding the Archer balance changes introduced in v0.4.23, we have reverted the following changes in today’s patch:
Rapid Fire 
Damage coefficient per hit: 60% → 80% 
Energy Cost: 4 → 3 
Arrow Rain 
Cooldown: 24s → 20s 
Sniping Shot 
Base Damage coefficient: 160% → 180% 
Additional Damage coefficient per unit of distance: 20% → 30% 
Sharp Shooter 
Critical Chance gained per completed kill objective stage: 3% → 7% 
As Dungeon Settlers is still in Early Access, we are working to deliver new content according to our roadmap while continuing to refine the existing game. Balance adjustments will remain part of that process, and we will take greater care when reviewing their overall impact.
Please continue sharing your thoughts with us through the Steam forums, Discord, QQ, or any of our other community channels. We truly appreciate every piece of feedback.
If you are enjoying the game, recommending it to your friends or leaving an honest Steam review would be a great help to our team.
Thank you again for your continued support.

[Update] v0.4.23 
Major Improvements & Fixes 
The option to 'Lock Consecration Results' has been separated into its own setting and is now available on all Management Difficulty levels. This option can also be turned ON or OFF during an ongoing campaign.
Soulstones can once again be purchased from dungeon merchants in Regions 1 and 2 , provided you do not currently own the corresponding Soulstone or Soul Trait.
Skills that can damage allies now have Auto Use disabled by default. 
Active Skill Energy costs are reduced based on Combat Difficulty >> 25% on Normal and 50% on Easy. 
Maximum Expedition size has been increased to 6 members at Rank 2 and 8 members at Rank 3. 
When an enemy outside your vision attacks an allied unit, the tile containing that enemy is revealed for approximately 2 seconds.
Reduced the Research Work Amount multiplier on higher Management Difficulties
>> Very Hard from 1.33× → 1.15×, and Devastation from 1.66× → 1.30×.
Balance adjustments have been made to equipment and skills so that higher-risk melee weapon types such as Spears and Greatswords are not excessively disadvantaged compared to ranged weapons such as Bows. This includes adjustments to Sharp Shooter.
The duration of Stun and Immobilizing effects has generally been increased.
The Game Guide now remembers the last viewed page, search term, list scroll position, and article scroll position when closed and reopened.
Added a news window that displays update announcements when launching the game.
Controls / Display Settings 
Added an option to adjust cursor size from 100% to 150% .
Mouse side buttons Mouse3 and Mouse4 can now be assigned as hotkeys.
Windowed Mode and Fullscreen Mode now remember their resolutions separately.
Borderless Windowed Mode now displays the actual display resolution.
When switching to Windowed Mode for the first time, the default size is now 1600×900 . On smaller displays, the window is automatically scaled down to fit the available workspace.
The mouse cursor can no longer leave the game screen while in Fullscreen Mode. This restriction is released when switching to another application or opening the Steam Overlay.
Crafting / Storage / Work 
Crafting quantities can now be entered directly as numbers.
Shift + Click can now be used to adjust crafting quantities in increments of 10.
Multiple storage containers of the same type can now be selected to change their storage policies at once.
Batch storage settings apply to Allow All / Ban All , individual item permissions, and durability ranges.
Fixed an issue where the previous search state could remain when searching again for shared items to haul.
Expedition Members / Prayer 
Fixed an issue where recruitment candidates could be generated above the maximum level available in the current build.
Fixed an issue where newly recruited members did not receive the Trait granted by the Deputy Leader.
The Trait now applies even when the Deputy Leader and recruited member are located separately between the settlement and dungeon.
Missing Deputy Leader Traits in existing save files are restored when loading the save.
Added an explanatory tooltip to the Expedition Member retirement button.
Injuries / Sleep / Combat Issues 
Surgery eligibility has been changed so that it applies to living units who have entered a Deadly state due to an injury.
The patient's condition is now checked again when surgery begins or resumes.
Fixed an issue where an exhausted unit's lying posture would not return to normal after leaving the Deadly state.
If a bed is destroyed while a unit is sleeping, the unit now transitions to the sleeping-on-the-floor animation.
Fixed an issue where the Distorted Senses environmental effect was not being applied to all eligible units. The effect is now also applied to units newly spawned in the dungeon.
Fixed an issue where certain Inscription and reflection effects could cause errors when there was no attacking entity.
The additional Attack Power granted on attack by the Giant and Divine Power Inscriptions is now displayed in the stat tooltip.
Skill / Weapon Balance 
Reduced the Accuracy penalty of Wood, Bloodwood, Bone, Carapace, Akron, Copper, and Wrought Iron Greatswords from -20 → -10. 
Two Hand Grip has been changed to continuously increase Physical Attack while its equipment conditions are met. The condition is now: equip a main-hand weapon that is not a two-handed weapon , while leaving the off-hand slot empty.
Reduced the Blue Stone Golem's Physical and Magic Resistance from 0 → -50 each.
Reduced the Physical Attack of Bows: Wood 23 → 18, Bloodwood 42 → 34, Bone 30 → 24, Carapace 36 → 29, Akron 57 → 46, Copper 45 → 36.
Skill / Effect
Changes
Destructive Split
Stun 1s → 2s , Cooldown 12s → 15s 
Slay
Stamina Cost 5 → 4 
Stun Charge
Stun 1s → 2s , Cooldown 15s → 18s 
Rapid Fire
Damage coefficient per hit 80% → 60% . The tooltip previously displayed 60%, but due to a data error, the skill was actually dealing 80%. Stamina Cost 3 → 4 
Arrow Rain
Cooldown 20s → 24s 
Sniping Shot
Base Damage coefficient 180% → 160% , additional Damage coefficient per distance 30% → 20% 
Summon Bubbling
Allied Shield coefficient on death 150% → 130% , Cooldown 20s → 24s 
Embracing Wave
Shield coefficient 300% → 260% 
Water Dive
Cooldown 20s → 24s 
Clinging Vines
Root and Stagger duration 3s → 6s , Cooldown 8s → 14s 
Snatching Prey
Root 3s → 6s 
Guardian’s Taunt
Taunt 4s → 6s 
Spear Basic Attack
Damage coefficient 75% → 90% 
Piercing Thrust
Damage coefficient 150% → 180% 
Twin Thrust
Damage coefficient per hit 50% → 70% 
Opening Strike
Damage coefficient 220% → 250% 
Quick Retreat
Haste duration 5s → 8s 
Charge Attack
Additional Damage coefficient per tile charged 30% → 40% 
Pommel Strike
Stun 2s → 1s 
Fire Missile
Attack Damage coefficient 100% → 130% , Burning applied 2 → 3 
Crimson Recoil
Shield gained on kill increased from 15% → 30% of missing HP 
Sharp Shooter
Critical Chance gained per completed kill objective stage 7% → 3% 
Initiative
Attack Speed increase at the start of combat 25% → 35% 
Brace Stance
Attack Speed gained per hit 2% → 4% , maximum increase 30% → 60% 
Dizziness
Stun duration triggered by stacks 1s → 2s 
Environment / Presentation 
Improved how buildings affected by rain are tracked and processed.
Torch Stands are no longer affected by rain damage.
Adjusted the positions of boundary and surprise effects for units occupying multiple tiles.
Adjusted the display height of regular and Abyss Chain Knight Sentinels.
Soulstone Repurchasing Condition 
The corresponding monster must have been defeated at least once during the current campaign.
The corresponding Soulstone must not exist in either the settlement or dungeon, and there must be no living Expedition Member with the corresponding Soul Trait.
If you left a previous dungeon without picking up the Soulstone, or if the member carrying the Soul died, the Soulstone can still be purchased as long as the requirements are met.
Both dungeon merchants sell the same 7 types of Soulstones , with one of each eligible type available for purchase.
If a repurchased Soulstone is lost again, it can be purchased again once the requirements are met.
Trading 
When confirming a trade, the game now rechecks item quantities, both sides' Gold, the receiving unit, available space, weight, and other relevant conditions.
When purchasing items by clicking in a dungeon, items are now assigned to an Expedition Member within trading range.
Fixed an error that could occur when there was no eligible member available to receive an item.
Trade success and failure sound effects now play correctly even after the Trade window has been closed.
Save Recovery 
Fixed an issue where the Critical Chance bonus from the Gold Mine Inscription was not applied correctly at maximum stacks.
Gold rewards from the Gold Mine Inscription can no longer exceed their maximum limit.
The accumulated progress and maximum-stack bonus of the Gold Mine Inscription are now restored correctly after saving and loading.
Gold Mine Inscription bonuses are now included in detailed stat breakdowns.
Guild Merchants that were incorrectly lost from save data are now restored after checking their appearance conditions. Merchants with a recorded death will not be restored.
Guild Merchant appearance events can now only occur in the settlement.
When loading a save with mismatched Decision, related Quest, or Reward states, invalid states are now cleaned up.
Movement / Work 
When multiple units are ordered to move into a floorless area in a dungeon, their destinations are now adjusted to nearby reachable positions.
Hauling, storage, construction preparation, and repair jobs now check both spaces occupied by units and reserved movement positions.
Units now check whether the hauling destination is reachable before picking up an item.
Improved handling so that jobs waiting for access and jobs with unreachable work positions are distinguished from one another.
Fixed repeated behavior where a unit would immediately pick up an item again after putting it down because its destination was blocked by another unit.
Unreachable repair work positions will no longer be selected.
Pathfinding wait requests for enemies in combat are now processed in order of highest Movement Speed first.
Pathfinding between disconnected areas now fails more quickly.
Guide / UI 
Game Guide state is now preserved when moving between the settlement, dungeons, and dungeon floors within the same play session. It is reset after reloading a save.
Mana Saturation now appears in the Environmental Effects list while active.
Fixed an issue where tooltips on the Difficulty Settings screen could reset incorrectly.
Text 
Added a dedicated icon for Mana Saturation .
Added descriptions and linked tooltips explaining the effects of each Mana Saturation stage.
Updated Xenon's dialogue and quests, as well as several event lines and color tags.
Revised and cleaned up various descriptions and translations for items, Traits, buildings, interactions, and the Game Guide.
Updated the Shift + Click crafting quantity instructions and corrected several trade failure translations.
Updated the description for hard combat difficulty.
Updated guidance text related to Auto Skills, surgery requirements, and other systems.
Etc 
Fixed an issue where progression could become blocked during the transition to the credits after clearing Region 2 due to audio restoration failing. 
Screen transitions will no longer wait indefinitely for an audio fade to finish.
Corrected the orientation of the Hunter's Workbench image.
Fixed tile visuals in several dungeon rooms.
Changed the corridor layout on the Region 2 Safe Floor to a straight configuration.
Auto Use settings already saved or manually changed by the player are preserved.
Fixed an issue where registering a skill again would overwrite its existing Auto Use setting and turn it ON.
Units now use tables belonging to a Dining Room when selecting a place to eat.
Fixed an issue where the “Unit Has Nothing to Do” notification could appear while a unit was merely waiting briefly.
Fixed an issue where repeatedly issuing movement commands while moving would restart the movement animation from the beginning.
When multiple units are selected, clicking a unit behind a building now prioritizes selecting that unit.
When using a Return Scroll, dead Expedition Members currently being carried will now return with the party.
Improved the Return Scroll process so that dungeon cleared/depleted states are not omitted.

Your Feedback in Action 
Hi! We have been closely following your feedback across our various community channels.
To address issues that many players have found frustrating as quickly as possible, we released three updates within the first three days of Early Access.
Below are some of the major changes we have implemented so far based on your feedback:
Changes Already Live in the Game 
Added options to lock individual character elements during the 'Expedition Founding' scenario, including portraits, ability stats, Major Traits(which determine skilltrees), and Sub Traits. 
The Create Campaign window can no longer be closed by pressing Esc or clicking outside the window. 
Changed the default difficulty from Hard to Normal. 
Limited the number of times Gloths can use their summoning skill from unlimited to a maximum of three. 
Gloths now move to an empty tile within one tile of their target after charging.
Removed the item drop quantity penalty on Very Hard and Devastation Management difficulties.
Reduced the weight of various items, including armor, helmets, bones, stone, clay, hard shells, silver and copper ores and ingots, bricks, and pottery.
Increased the maximum arrow stack size from 100 to 200.
Rebalanced Abyss Chest rewards by increasing reward quantities.
Added a guide for Auto Skills.
Reworked the Fire skill 'Explosion'.
Added a Mute in Background option.
Increased the repeated tutorial notification interval from 18 to 24 seconds.
Fixed an issue where Chinese and Japanese unit names were not displayed correctly when creating an Expedition Team.
Camera zoom tutorial objectives can now be completed using the keys assigned to Camera Zoom In and Camera Zoom Out.
Changes we are preparing ASAP 
We are also reviewing and planning improvements for the following issues, with the goal of addressing them as soon as possible:
Expanding the option to lock Ability stats Increases or Inscriptions when leveling up to all difficulty levels (currently available only on Easy and Normal) 
Granting vision of an enemy’s tile when they attack from outside the party’s field of vision
Reducing the burden of having to rest too frequently due to Stamina.
Adjusting how far units will take detours during combat to reduce unexpected movement in narrow passages.
Improving situations where units cannot move because tiles have been reserved by monsters.
Many other changes and fixes have also been implemented. You can find the complete patch notes released so far at the links below:
\[Update] v0.4.12 
\[Update] v0.4.17 
\[Update] v0.4.19 
We will continue listening to your feedback, tracking your suggestions, discussing them internally, and responding through future updates. 
Please rest assured that we are carefully reading your feedback. Time constraints may prevent us from implementing every requested feature immediately, but we will continue addressing your feedback through future updates.
Steam Reviews 
We’d love to hear your thoughts on Dungeon Settlers through a Steam review.
Your reviews help us understand which parts of the game are working well, which areas need more attention, and what you would like us to explore in future updates. They also help us better understand what matters most to players as we decide what to prioritize in upcoming patches.
As with this announcement, we’re keeping a close eye on what you’re sharing, and every bit of feedback helps us shape Dungeon Settlers throughout Early Access!
Thank you for joining us on the journey with Dungeon Settlers. 
We look forward to hearing more from you!

[Update] v0.4.17 
\[Features & Improvements]
- Added a Portrait Lock option to Recruit Expedition Members
: You can now keep the current candidate’s portrait and appearance when selecting Recruit Again.
- Added a Mute in Background option
: When enabled, the game is muted while its window is inactive. This option is enabled by default.
- Improved save version compatibility warnings
: Compatibility warnings now appear only when loading a save from a different version series, such as v0.3.x → v0.4.x.
\[Combat]
- Reworked Explosion
: Its base damage remains unchanged at 400% of Magic Attack Power.
: Removed the additional damage based on the target’s Burning stacks ×10.
: It now applies 5 stacks of Burning for 10 seconds to affected targets.
: Reduced its casting time from 2.88 → 1.88 seconds and its related VFX duration from 4 → 3 seconds.
\[Other]
- Camera zoom tutorial objectives can now be completed using the keys assigned to Camera Zoom In and Camera Zoom Out.
- Fixed an issue where the Recruitment refresh confirmation pop-up would not close properly when using the key assigned to Confirm Notice.
- Increased the repeated tutorial notification interval from 18 → 24 seconds. Tutorial notification sounds are now suppressed while the Skill window is open.
\[Bug Fix]
- Fixed an issue where inspecting a Female Gloth displayed an empty skill entry.
- Replaced the Guard Captain character sprite.
- Updated the Vampire Potion description to clarify that attacks drain a fixed amount of Health for a limited time. Its actual effect remains unchanged.
- Corrected the Carapace Processing research tiers displayed in some Expedition Resolutions.
- Updated the Inventory guide with the following controls:
: Ctrl + Drag: Move half of an item stack.
: Shift + Drag: Choose the quantity to move.
: These controls already existed; this update only adds them to the guide.
- Corrected several translations and text entries, including Spanish and German localization.
Fixed an issue where NPCs could become hostile even when they dodged an attack.
Fixed an issue where clicking Confirm could be ignored when multiple confirmation pop-ups overlapped.
- Fixed an issue where Healing Touch took priority over First Aid when right-clicking a downed ally.
- Fixed an issue where Bubble Toad’s Basic Attack animation would occasionally fail to play.
- Fixed some VFX and particle effects not properly adjusting their playback speed when the game speed was changed.
- Fixed an issue where the settlement BGM would not resume after the credits ended.

Thank You for Playing! & Community Events 
Hi everyone! It's been about a day since Dungeon Settlers entered Early Access, and first of all, thank you so much for joining us and supporting the game! 
It's been incredibly exciting for us to finally see you playing the game, building your settlements, exploring the dungeons, and sharing your experiences with us.
At the same time, even in this first day, seeing how you play and reading through your reactions and reviews has given us a better sense of where the game still needs improvement. We're grateful for everything you've shared with us so far, and we'll continue listening closely as Early Access moves forward.
What We're Working On
Just a few hours after launch yesterday, we released our first update addressing several bugs and improvements we identified from the early hours of Early Access.
We're already preparing another update to address issues and improvements that we believe need more immediate attention. For example, we're working to quickly add the option to lock character portraits in the Expedition Founding scenario, based on your feedback. At the same time, we're continuing to review your feedback and looking closely at quality-of-life improvements, balance, and other areas where we can make the overall experience better.
There's still a lot ahead of us, and we'll keep working hard to make Dungeon Settlers better throughout Early Access!
Early Access Community Events
To celebrate the Early Access launch, we're holding two community events on our official Discord! 
\[Link to Discord] 
https://discord.gg/CCy3hkgDtA 
Event Period: 
September 5, 2:00 PM UTC – September 14, 2:00 PM UTC
\[Event] Show Us Your Settlement Event 
https://discord.com/channels/1183974679451541616/1545741038839398410 
Show us the settlement you've built!
Share screenshots of your settlement on our Discord and show the community what you've created.
Winners 
🏆 Top 3 — Submissions with the most likes
⭐ Developer's Pick — 2 submissions
\[Event] Best Guide Event 
https://discord.com/channels/1183974679451541616/1545741085932912670 
Share your knowledge and help your fellow settlers!
Create a guide about Dungeon Settlers. It can be about strategies, useful tips, character builds, settlement management, dungeon exploration, or anything else you think would help other players.
Guides in any language are welcome! 
Winners 
🏆 Top 3 — Submissions with the most likes
⭐ Developer's Pick — 2 submissions
Rewards
We'll have 10 winners in total , and each winner will get to request one character portrait to be added to Dungeon Settlers! 
Please feel free

Early Access Game
Get instant access and start playing; get involved with this game as it develops.
Note: Games in Early Access are not complete and may or may not change further. If you are not excited to play this game in its current state, then you
should wait to see if the game progresses further in development. Learn more 
What the developers have to say:
Why Early Access?
“Dungeon Settlers is a game built around many interconnected systems, including settlement management, dungeon exploration, and tactical combat. We believe the best way to refine these systems is by working closely with the community.
Early Access gives us the opportunity to gather feedback from players with different playstyles, improve balance and usability, identify issues that only appear at scale, and continue expanding the game while shaping it together with our community.”
Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?
“We currently expect Dungeon Settlers to remain in Early Access for approximately 2 years.
This timeframe may change depending on development progress and community feedback. Our goal is to leave Early Access when we believe the game offers the level of polish and content we are aiming for.
Throughout Early Access, we plan to continue releasing regular updates with new content, improvements, and refinements.”
How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?
“During Early Access, we plan to continue expanding the game with additional regions, monsters, weapons, skills, races, events, and other gameplay content.
We will continue improving combat and management balance, UI/UX, optimization, localization, and overall game polish based on community feedback and our own development goals.
In addition, we plan to prepare modding support, including Steam Workshop integration, to make it easier for the community to create and share their own content.”
What is the current state of the Early Access version?
“The Early Access version already contains the complete core gameplay loop.
Players can build and expand a settlement, recruit and manage expedition members, explore dungeons, gather resources, craft equipment, research technologies, and engage in realtime with pause combat.
The current Early Access version allows players to play through the first two dungeon regions from beginning to end, offering many hours of gameplay. Additional regions, content, balancing, and quality of life improvements are planned throughout Early Access.”
Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?
“We plan to increase the price when the game leaves Early Access and reaches its full release, reflecting the additional content, features, and overall quality of the game.”
How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?
“We plan to actively gather player feedback through the Steam Community and our official Discord server. Community feedback will play an important role in helping us improve balance, refine existing systems, and prioritize future content throughout Early Access.”

About This Game
Dungeon Settlers is a dark fantasy strategy game that combines colony simulation and dungeon crawling. As the leader of an expedition sent by the Guild, your mission is to explore, conquer, and destroy the dungeon which is the source of all calamities. To do so, you’ll need to build a settlement in the barren land and prepare your people for the dangers ahead.
This is a ‘Hardcore Strategy’ game. Train your members strategically by considering their equipment, skills, and traits, then form a party of up to four. In real-time with pause tactical combat with no turn or round limits, analyze enemy traits and patterns to outmaneuver them and achieve victory. But remember once dead, there is no coming back...
Build a settlement in the desolate land, isolated by magical erosion. Design rooms freely by placing walls and doors to meet your members’ needs—create bedrooms and dining areas, and set up a forge with anvils and smelters. Cultivate fields to grow crops. Manage your resources efficiently to survive, and produce rations and camping supplies for the next expedition. Unlock new buildings and equipment through research.
Each member has six major abilities and talents, along with dozens of combat and life-related stats. They also possess various traits based on race, background, and personality—such as a curious Lizardman with a drifter’s past. Recruit promising candidates and help them grow through leveling. Equip them with powerful equipments and carefully build a four-member expedition party with synergistic skill trees such as sword/mace/bow/fire magic.
Combat takes place in real time, but you can pause at any moment to think strategically. Plan your tactics using a variety of effects and mechanics—stun, bleed, burn, provoke, vulnerable, charge attacks, summons, and more. Position your party wisely, exploit enemy weaknesses, and utilize your skills at the right time. Even hopeless battles can be overcome with the right strategy.
Each dungeon expedition is randomly composed, with floors and rooms changing each time. Regions apply different random environmental effects. The deeper you go, the rarer and more valuable the resources become—but so do the threats. You’ll encounter the remnants of magical experiments, such as towering golems or acid-spitting monsters. Secure wood logs, herbs, gemstone veins, and mysterious mandrake. Trade with dungeon merchants, and face ancient tree that demand blood to bear forbidden fruit.
